transcript:
MARTIN: David... You HAVE to listen-

DAVID (He starts to sob): The fire's eating away at them. Their skin is bubbling. They're trying to scream, but there's no sound. Their tongues are turning to ash. Their lips are melting off. It's like they're smiling. Please... Forgive me! I’m sorry... I’m so sorry... The demon HAD to die... HAD to go... We all have to sacrifice ourselves... I have to join you too... Please just stop staring... I didn’t want to hurt any of you... Especially you... Especially you... 

His voice is faint now.

DAVID (CONT’D): Please... Just let go... Let the fire take you... Cleanse his evil out of you... They won’t be able to hurt you anymore...
